items.title: n0n leak allegedly tied to JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard customers
items.summary: The n0n extortion group leaked data allegedly tied to the three companies' customers, and the companies point to incidents at third-party providers; the report does not describe any encryption.

items.title: Gentlemen group lists Nvidia; Nvidia finds no compromise
items.summary: In a November 19 report, Nvidia said it found no sign its systems were compromised after the Gentlemen ransomware group listed it as a victim.

items.title: Advantage Archives Inc. claimed by INC Ransom
items.summary: A leak-site tracker lists the US firm with an attack date of November 13; this is the group's claim, seen in a search summary only, and no victim confirmation was found.

items.title: Leware Construction Company listed as a victim
items.summary: A leak-site tracker shows the US construction firm as discovered on November 11; this was seen in a search summary only, and no victim confirmation was found.

items.title: Kazakh ransomware suspect extradited from Italy
items.summary: The Record reported on November 17 that a Kazakh ransomware hacking suspect was extradited from Italy.

ransomware.note: No victim-confirmed ransomware attack from the last 24 hours was found. Leak-site and extortion claims are unverified.

items.title: Microsoft 365: 18-hour email outage traced to a July fix
items.summary: Microsoft restored email and other Microsoft 365 services on November 13 and later blamed a software defect introduced in a July fix.

items.title: Microsoft 365 customers must apply for reimbursement
items.summary: The Register reported on November 18 that Microsoft is asking customers affected by the outage to apply for reimbursement.

items.title: UK government's Microsoft concentration risk
items.summary: A minister admitted on or before November 17 that up to 99% of UK civil servants rely on Microsoft for communications, in coverage following the 18-hour outage.

items.title: FAA ground stop blamed on faulty copper wiring
items.summary: The FAA attributed the November 13 ground stop to faulty copper wiring.

items.title: A week of outages linked largely to routine maintenance
items.summary: A November 17 analysis of a week of high-profile network outages, Apple's among them, found they were largely attributed to routine maintenance.

items.title: AWS also had an outage, columnist reports
items.summary: A November 21 column says AWS had a little-noticed outage during the recent run of incidents; its date and scope were not available in the summary reviewed.

outage.note: No new major AWS, Azure or Google Cloud outage from the last 24 hours was found. Items are from November 13-21 and are based on headlines and article summaries.

items.title: FBI investigates apparent hack of national criminal justice database
items.summary: An AP source said the FBI is investigating an apparent hack of a key national law enforcement database it maintains, according to a November 21 report.

items.title: China-linked AI agents exploited MONAI Label zero-day
items.summary: Amazon says a China-linked actor used autonomous AI agents to find and exploit a critical flaw in MONAI Label medical software, in findings reported November 21.

items.title: VMware vCenter flaw exploited before patch
items.summary: Google says a China-linked group exploited a critical vCenter authentication bypass before Broadcom released its patch, in findings reported November 19.

items.title: West Virginia Legislature hit by cyber incident
items.summary: The Record reported on November 20 that a cyber incident affected the West Virginia Legislature's IT systems.

items.title: Container Store restores systems after cyberattack
items.summary: The retailer restored systems after a cyberattack, The Record reported on November 20.

items.title: WhatsApp fixes flaw found during scam-campaign takedown
items.summary: WhatsApp fixed CVE-2026-23871, which it uncovered while disrupting a scam campaign, as reported November 20.

items.title: Puppet Enterprise flaw added to KEV
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-115731, a Perforce Puppet Enterprise deserialization flaw, to the KEV catalog on November 17.

items.title: KEV deadline November 24: Outlook, Chrome, BroadWorks, Openwave
items.summary: Federal remediation is due Tuesday for four of the six flaws CISA added on November 10; the two Barracuda fixes were due November 13.

cyber.note: Several items are based on headlines and summaries. Correction to the November 21 edition: the Node2Shell KEV addition it listed dates from October 27, with a federal deadline of November 10.

items.title: Cyclone Akvan landfall in eastern India; 300,000+ evacuated
items.summary: Akvan came ashore near Gopalpur on November 20 and weakened, with more than 300,000 people evacuated in Odisha.

items.title: Florida Space Coast at high risk of excessive rainfall
items.summary: A high-risk rainfall outlook covered the Space Coast on November 20 as the St. Johns River near Cocoa reached 5.67 m.

items.title: Low near SE Florida and Bahamas may develop
items.summary: As of November 20 the National Hurricane Center gave the low a 30% chance of subtropical or tropical development in 48 hours and 50% in seven days; check the current outlook.

items.title: Ecuador El Niño floods: toll reaches 14
items.summary: Floods killed two people in Guayaquil and 172.8 mm of rain swamped Milagro, taking Ecuador's toll to 14 as of November 16.

items.title: Santa Catarina, Brazil: 671 storm incidents
items.summary: Storms on November 4-5 caused 671 incidents across 76 municipalities, with one death and more than 110 people rescued.

items.title: M 6.8 earthquake, 105 km NE of Lospalos, Timor-Leste
items.summary: The November 21 quake carries a green USGS PAGER alert and no tsunami flag.

items.title: M 6.7 earthquake, 9 km NE of Carhuamayo, Peru
items.summary: The November 21 quake carries a green USGS PAGER alert; its tsunami flag is set, which does not by itself mean a tsunami occurred.

items.title: M 6.6 earthquake, 149 km WSW of Tual, Indonesia
items.summary: The November 16 Banda Sea quake carries a green USGS PAGER alert.

items.title: M 5.9 earthquake, 238 km SW of Yanglong, China
items.summary: The November 21 quake carries a yellow USGS PAGER alert, indicating possible localized casualties or damage.

items.title: M 5.3 earthquake, 17 km ESE of Comandău, Romania
items.summary: The November 18 quake carries a green USGS PAGER alert.

physical.note: The Cyclone Murasu item in the November 21 edition is not carried forward because its date and source could not be verified today.
